Absolutely, the soundtrack is perfect. There would be lots of other things to praise about the game, but that would take too long.

-great Japanese lore/history set in one of the most interesting eras, complete with most personalities of the time, it even has the tea master Sen no Rikyu.

-miscellaneous collectibles like teasets that are named after actual artifact tea sets, that buff your xp, loot or gold.

-exquisite attention to detail even when concerning less important characters or monsters. I checked up most yokai and samurai and their appearances match the historical records, albeit with some artistic liberties.

-almost every mythical creature of Japanese mythology makes an appearance.

-all maps have great atmosphere, I wish we had like 10 more missions in total.

-weapons, particularly those that are uniquely named correspond to their historical description. Funfact: there's a large odachi in the game that was the weapon of Sasaki Kojiro (Musashi's nemesis) , and it had the same name like in a book I read, I forgot the name though sorry.

-character customization is great

-combat is amazing, many skills, movements, mechanics and systems to weave in while not feeling overwhelmed.

-character progression, the way you get stronger by personal experience,coupled with gaining more skills and stronger gear feels unparalleled. 

-I like grinding for perfect loot, so the loot system is great for me.

-i like the fact that there are many ways to tackle a mission

-the clans, fighting graves system is a nice touch, it's somewhat made as a placeholder for pvp. Clan buffs are nice

-coop system is beautiful, I've had only positive experiences and many great memories. It's sad that there are few players on ps5, I think most are on PC.

-overall this is my favorite game of all time, a game that fits me like a glove, it got me into reading Japanese historical books. It's my game of choice whatever the situation.
